entry.title: Routing entanglement through quantum networks published in PR Research.

link.title: Routing entanglement through quantum networks published in PR Research.

entry.content: Our new paper on routing entanglement through quantum networks on the ArXiv has finally been published in Physical Review Research. It has been one hell of a ride and it is very satisfying to finally see this paper online.
entry.summary: Routing entanglement through quantum networks published in Phys. Rev. Research!

entry.title: Contract signed with NTT Basic Research Laboratory.

link.title: Contract signed with NTT Basic Research Laboratory.

entry.content: I will join NTT’s Basic Research Laboratory as a Senior Research and Development Scientist later this year. This is going to bring me to Japan to work with the local Nanomechanics Research Group as well as to work on my research projects.

entry.title: Quantum zeno Blockade paper published.
entry.content: Our new paper on the quantum Zeno effect in optomechanical systems on the ArXiv is out now in Physical Review Research. Feel free to get in touch if you are interested.

entry.title: Quantumalta at 100 years of quantum mechanics 2025 in Helgoland, Germany.

link.title: Quantumalta at 100 years of quantum mechanics 2025 in Helgoland, Germany.

entry.content:
I got the chance to present a poster about our latest work on “Routing entanglement in quantum networks” at the 100th birthday of quantum mechanics conference by the Max Planck Society in Helgoland, Germany.

Listening to the historic talks on quantum mechanics with Nobel contemporaries in Hamburg, Germany.

Recap about the conference dinner in Hamburg.

Me presenting our poster on routing of entanglement in quantum networks in Helgoland, Germany.

Recap on the conference in Helgoland and a link to Physics World referring to me as part of the creme de la creme of quantum physics.

entry.title: Xjenza Online Vol. 12 Issue 2 released
entry.content: The last 2024 issue of Xjenza Online, Xjenza Online Vol. 12 Issue 2, is now online. The topics in this issue are again a mixed bag of different disciplines covering healthcare, English language use at European universities, Sociology, and many more. I am simply flattered by the nice words in the editorial by the Editor-in-Chief, Prof. Cristiana Sebu. I can only say thank you for having me on the team. Let’s keep the issues coming in 2025.

entry.title: Xjenza Online Vol. 12 Issue 1 released
entry.content: The latest issue of Xjenza Online, Xjenza Online Vol. 12 Issue 1, is now online. This time around the topics cover a variety of different disciplines ranging from medicine, biology and farming, to education during the COVID-19 pandemic. It was a pleasure putting together all these diverse articles.

entry.title: Xjenza Online Vol. 12 Special Issue (Economics and Finance) released

link.title: Xjenza Online Vol. 12 Special Issue (Economics and Finance) released

entry.content: The first issue, Xjenza Online Vol. 12 Special Issue (Economics and Finance), that I took care of as copy editor is now online. The local experts on economics and finance discuss diverse topics, such as house purchase affordability in Malta, core inflation, and retirement savings among others. I am proud of this first effort as copy editor for Xjenza Online and I am looking forward to many more articles to finish.
entry.summary: First issue of Xjenza Online finished
